breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the uniform load by its single resultant for an exact deflection calculation, but equivalent resultants preserve force and moment, not the full beam-deflection response.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the exact UDL cantilever formulas (delta_max = wL^4 / (8EI) and theta_max = wL^3 / (6EI)) applied directly to the uniformly distributed load. It does not replace the distributed load with a point resultant at midspan, thereby fixing the inconsistency present in the incomplete prompt. This aligns with the ground truth prompt which simply asks for the exact deflection and slope under the UDL.
